title: Differential gene expression in visceral abdominal adipose tissue in coronary artery disease (Franzén et al. 2016)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Cardiometabolic risk loci share downstream cis- and trans-gene regulation across tissues and diseases.
Franzén O et al.
Science. 2016 Aug 19;353(6301):827-30. doi: 10.1126/science.aad6970.
PMID: 27540175

The genes listed below are those found in this study to be differentially expressed in visceral abdominal adipose tissue of individuals with coronary artery disease, relative to samples from matched individuals without coronary artery disease. The plot and table show only the top 1,000 genes (with the lowest adjusted p-values). The full results are accessible at the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.

These data were generated by the STARNET (Stockholm-Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Networks Engineering Task) study. Explore integrated tissue-specific gene expression data at the STARNET website.
